sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Morning shift deployed; being debriefed by night shift.
Gearing up to head on patrol.
Heading on patrol towards Aotea Square while conducting welfare checks on businesses.
Starbucks, Queen St McDonald's, 77 Convenience Store and Localito all clear. Heading towards Aotea Square.
Area all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards Federal St via Wellesley St.
Both 77 Convenience Stores, Eighty Fed and Coffee Club all clear, no suspicious activity. Standing by for security presence.
Sweep through Elliott and Darby St all clear, no issues. Heading to Lorne St.
Checked in at the Library, then Lorne St all clear, no issues. Standing by for security presence.
Welfare check on McDonald's Queen St; requested by staff to move a vagrant along.
Vagrant has been moved along, no further issues. (Note: no footage captured.) Heading back to HQ to stand by for B team.
B team onsite; standing by while debriefing.
Debrief with B team complete. Commencing patrol down Queen St while B team patrols upper Queen St.
Response call from Daniel (Professional Security) requesting assistance to verbally trespass and move a vagrant along from outside Dunkin Donuts; making our way over now.
Arrived at Dunkin Donuts; in the process of issuing and moving the vagrant along.
Vagrant has been moved along with no issues. Standing by at Dunkin Donuts for 15 minutes to ensure the vagrant moves along completely. No further issues.
Stand-down complete, no issues; vagrant has fully moved along. Resuming patrol heading to Commercial Bay.
Arriving at Commercial Bay, commencing sweep; no issues on the local stores on lower Queen St.
Full sweep on Commercial Bay, Tyler St, Commerce St complete, no issues. Continuing patrol to Gore, Fort St.
Gore / Fort St welfare check complete, no issues on local businesses.
Response call from the Auckland Council compliance team requesting assistance to verbally trespass and move along a vagrant loitering outside Smith and Caugheys; making our way now.
Arrived at the location; issued and moved the vagrant along with no further issues. Standing by while the vagrant packs up his belongings.
Vagrant has packed up and vacated the premises, no further issues. Standing by.
Response call from Peter Alexander reporting a theft from the store; a vagrant had taken $368 worth of merchandise.
Vagrant found and stolen merchandise recovered and returned to the store, no further issues. Standing by at Peter Alexander as the vagrant who stole is causing public disturbances in the area.
Standing down and resuming patrol. Heading back to HQ to debrief with B team and swap routes.
Standing by HQ; debrief with B team.
Route changeover with B team complete. A team commencing patrol up Queen St while B team patrols lower Queen St. Heading to Aotea Square.
Welfare check on stores within the vicinity of upper Queen St complete, no issues to report.
Sweep on Aotea Sq clear, no issues. Heading up to Victoria St.
Welfare sweep on Elliott St, no issues. Continuing patrol to Victoria St.
Victoria Street sweep complete, no issues. Heading back onto Queen St to maintain security presence.
Heading back to HQ for our 30-minute break.
Morning shift complete, no issues to report. Auror report complete. Handover to afternoon shift complete.

sections.title: Day Shift — Team 2 (09:00 – 17:00)
items: B team deployed; standing by HQ for debrief.
Brief meeting with A team complete, no issues to report. Commencing patrols upper Queen Street. Welfare checks:
Welfare checks completed, all clear, no issues, nothing to report.
Welfare sweep complete, no issues to report. Heading up to Victoria.
Arrived at Victoria St; welfare check completed on Elliott and Darby, no issues. Commencing welfare sweep.
Full welfare sweep on Victoria St complete, no issues. Heading to Lorne St for welfare check and maintaining security presence.
Security presence maintained; arrived and completed a full welfare sweep on Lorne St, no issues from local stores.
Upper Queen St patrol complete, no issues / response calls to report. Standing by maintaining security presence on Queen St.
Security presence on upper Queen St maintained, no issues. Commencing welfare sweeps on Lorne St, Aotea, Victoria, Federal, Elliott and Darby. Standing by.
Welfare check on Lorne St complete, no issues.
Welfare sweep through Elliott / Darby complete.

Welfare sweep on Victoria St and Federal St complete, no issues. Welfare checks complete, no issues from local stores or the public. No response calls. Resuming security presence on Queen St until changeover with Team 1.
Heading back to HQ for route changeover.
B team debrief with A team complete. Commencing patrol down Queen St.
All local stores on lower Queen St clear, no issues to report.
Standing by Commercial Bay. Resuming patrol on lower Queen St, heading to Chancery.
Full welfare sweep on High St, Freyberg Sq, no issues on local stores.
Chancery Sq welfare sweep complete, no issues. Continuing patrol to Fort / Gore.
Welfare sweep on the rest of High St clear, no issues to report.
Vulcan Lane welfare sweep clear, no issues. Heading back onto lower Queen St to maintain security presence until route changeover at HQ.
Standing by HQ debriefing with Team 1 before route changeover and taking our break.
Debriefing complete, no issues to report. Route changeover clear. Commencing welfare checks up Queen St.
Welfare check on all local stores on upper Queen St going to Aotea, clear, no issues. Making our way to Aotea.
Aotea Square welfare sweep complete, no issues. Heading to Victoria St while keeping up security presence.
Welfare sweep through Elliott / Darby St clear, no issues. Continuing patrol to Victoria.
Victoria welfare sweep clear, no issues on stores or public. Heading down to Lorne St.
Arrived at Lorne St, commencing welfare sweep.
Lorne St welfare sweep clear, no issues on stores. Making our way to Auckland Library.
Auckland Library welfare check clear, no issues. Moving back onto Queen St to maintain security presence on upper Queen St.
Upper Queen St welfare sweeps complete, no issues. Standing by while keeping up security presence.
Report up to date. Commencing final sweep before Team 2 stand down.
Final sweep on Lorne St, Aotea, Victoria, Federal, Elliott and Darby. No issues from all upper Queen St stores, no public issues.
Team 2 standing down, no issues to report. All equipment handover complete. No further issues.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone. Guards: Henry (14:30–22:30), Beni (14:30–22:30).
14:30–18:00 patrol cycle. Conducted patrols, full sweeps and thorough welfare checks through:
Received a response call from McDonald's Britomart regarding a male blocking the entrance and being aggressive towards members of the public and staff. No further issues, continuing patrols.
Received a response call from the OPSM store on Queen Street regarding a male who had broken in and entered the property and was causing a scene, yelling and shouting at staff.
Arrived at the OPSM store; the male was already gone and police were on scene on arrival. We assisted the officers in finding the male who broke in.

We and the officers found the male who broke in at the corner of the Chemist Warehouse on Wyndham Street; we issued a 2-year verbal trespass notice before the officers arrested him and took him away. No further issues, continuing patrols. (POI photos on file.)
Heading back with Team 2 to headquarters to swipe them upstairs to finish reports, hand over equipment and conclude operational duties.
Response call from the Auckland Council wardens requesting assistance to move vagrants sleeping outside a business on Queen Street near the Avachi chicken store across from McDonald's.
Arrived at the scene and successfully moved the vagrants along; they complied and left, no further issues, continuing patrols.
18:10–21:40 patrol cycle. Conducted patrols, full sweeps and welfare checks through:
Started making our way back towards headquarters to do floor checks.
Arrived at Headquarters; commencing floor checks.
Finished floor checks and started our 30-minute scheduled break; finished off our Auror reports.
Received a call from the Radisson Hotel on High Street regarding a female who was yelling at customers and staff.
Arrived at the Radisson Hotel; the female was already gone on arrival, no further issues.
Received a response call from McDonald's on Queen Street; a vagrant was loitering outside the entrance and yelling aggressively at passersby.
Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street and successfully moved the vagrant down a few stores, no further issues. Heading back to Headquarters for break and handover.
Afternoon shift completed, equipment accounted for. Handover to night shift completed. (All incident videos recorded on body cams for evidence.)

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone. Guards: Rico, Beni. Shift roster 22:30–06:30.
Briefing completed, equipment checked; commencing night shift patrol operations from headquarters.

Due to heavy rain and thunder throughout the night, the majority of the shift was based from headquarters. Patrols were conducted when weather conditions improved, with breaks under sheltered areas in the CBD during constant heavy rain; we remained available and ready for response calls throughout the shift.

23:00–02:00 patrol cycle. Patrolled through Upper and Lower Queen Street, Vulcan Lane, Customs Street, High Street, Chancery Square, Fort Street, Pocket Park, Fort Lane, Gore Street, Britomart, Lorne Street and Commercial Bay. Welfare checks on open stores and staff:
Returned to headquarters to do floor checks.
Floor checks completed; standing by due to weather conditions and awaiting response calls.

03:00–05:45 patrol cycle. Conducted the same patrol route through Upper and Lower Queen Street, Vulcan Lane, Customs Street, High Street, Chancery Square, Fort Street, Pocket Park, Fort Lane, Gore Street, Britomart, Lorne Street and Commercial Bay. Welfare checks on open stores and staff:
Standing by in sheltered areas just outside Britomart McDonald's, maintaining a visible presence and waiting for response calls.
Received a response call from Jo & Joe regarding a female who wouldn't leave the store even when closed; responded right away.

Arrived at Jo & Joe's; spoke to staff and spotted the female sitting inside the lobby area. We got her out of the store, talked to her and asked why she had been in the store so long; she was only staying inside to keep warm and out of the rain. We escorted her to another sheltered location that was also warm and had WiFi. No further issues.
Heading back to office to start our 30-minute break.
Night shift completed; equipment checked and handed over to morning shift.
